courtStatusMetadata.selectionQuestion: Which Pennsylvania criminal procedural rule governs the disposition recorded by the clerk for this case?

selectors.when: The docket records a summary-case disposition governed by Pa.R.Crim.P. 490.
The docket records a court-case disposition governed by Pa.R.Crim.P. 790.

courtStatusMetadata.noInferenceRule: Do not select from the charge label, packet directory name, or user recollection. Stop for clerk/court-status confirmation when the docket does not establish Rule 490 versus Rule 790.

serviceCertificate.appliesTo: the exact petition packet selected by courtStatusMetadata
requiredStatements: Identify every served packet component by exact document name.
State the date and method of service.
Identify the attorney for the Commonwealth or prosecuting office served and its service address.
Include the server's signature and signature date.
serviceCertificate.authorityLimit: This specification does not determine a locally accepted service method or create output-level legal approval. If the committed court record does not state the permitted method, stop for court-specific confirmation.
